text:
marta: Quick thought – what if we formalize a "micro-contract" that every hosting adapter implements: a tiny request envelope, capability matrix, and a fixed set of fallback hints. Goal: one SDK surface, different adapters.

kai: I like the micro-contract idea. keep it minimal: request metadata + capabilities + observability tags. adapters should be explicit about missing features.

devon: For secrets, core should only carry `secret_ref` strings (no keys). adapters translate that to KMS/HSM calls. private can map to customer HSM, hosted to our KMS.

sam: Telemetry: require adapters to set `hosting.mode`, `tenant.normalized`, and `adapter.version` on spans. Also expose `adapter.reported_capabilities` on diagnostics API.

marta: Example capability vocabulary we can standardize: streaming, kv_cache, quantization:{none,8bit,4bit}, hsm_signing. adapters report truthfully.

kai: Migration: add `X-Adapter-Compat: legacy|micro-v1` header so runtime can enable a compatibility shim for older adapters.

devon: Runtime behavior: if app requests unavailable capability, adapter returns structured error: `{code:412, reason:"capability_missing", hint:"fallback:polling"}`. Keep hints enumerated and stable.

sam: Ops requirement: adapter must pass a conformance suite before we route production traffic. We'll need unit + CI + integration checks.

talia-bot: infra-bot created INF-8110: adapter conformance harness + capability mismatch alerting. ETA: 3 sprints.

marta: Next steps: I'll draft RFC with micro-contract spec, capability list, and migration checklist. Kai/Devon please draft shim semantics + security rules. Sam will update tracing doc.

kai: One more: allow request-level hints `desired_latency_ms` and `cost_tier` so adapters can select kernels/quantization. keep values advisory only.

devon: Security note: adapters must never log plaintext secrets or keys in control-plane logs. add that as a must-pass check in conformance.

sam: Sounds good. I'll add reviewers and we can iterate.
